steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: I've turned into this hideous thing again... No wonder everyone hates me... Even my destined lover finds me repulsive...

steps.speaker: Graves?
steps.content: Careful, Graves! He's getting closer, he's going to see us like this, see how ugly we truly are! Then we'll never deserve happiness again!
steps.female_content: Careful, Graves! She's getting closer, she's going to see us like this, see how ugly we truly are! Then we'll never deserve happiness again!

steps.content: Moonlight pours through the high window, casting mottled patterns of light and shadow over the floor. For a moment, you think you see two figures, their shapes twisting and blending together in the dim glow. But when you try to focus, only a single monster remains, her body riddled with contamination.
Seeing you approach, she frantically raises her deformed hands, desperately trying to hide her face.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Stay back! Y-you've got the wrong person, I'm not Graves... I know nothing about this castle, true love, or any ring!
Her denial only makes her seem more suspicious.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Then I'll go find the real Graves and ask her what all this is about.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: No, you can't! Our wedding isn't over yet!

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: The ceremony isn't complete yet—you haven't even put on the ring... We haven't kissed, the guests haven't given their speeches. And there's still the cake, the champagne, the banquet, Mr. Crow's singing performance, and the spider couple's dance...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Wait... kiss?

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: No!

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: No!
You let out a soft laugh, finally feeling some of the tension release. Her perfect bride facade has vanished, revealing a glimpse of her childlike innocence.

This situation isn't so bad—it's even within your "comfort zone." The coffin reminds you of the Romanesque Hall, the decor echoes the style of Sloane Street, and the ghost story brings to mind the Buonanotte Factory. An unfamiliar, enclosed space thick with Mania, an unstable Sinner with inexplicable fixation...
It's practically tailor-made for you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't worry, I won't come closer. Let's just talk, okay? Graves, you want to get married, to complete this ceremony, right?

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Right... not just any wedding ceremony. I want the most perfect, most blissful one.

Graves remains huddled in the shadows, nervously tracing circles on the ground with her finger. Her joints are completely deformed, sharp black claws faintly visible. The moment she notices your gaze, she quickly withdraws her fingers, burying them in her palms.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Why are you so obsessed with weddings?
Graves doesn't respond.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Why are you so fixated on <color=#fb9259>me</color>?
The silence lingers. She yearns for a wedding yet refuses to confront the truth behind her obsession. Surely, there's more to your connection than just this hastily woven "love story."

But seeing how her body trembles uncontrollably, pushing her further could trigger another emotional breakdown and Mania outburst. Whether your goal is to gather more information, or to wait for MBCC's rescue at dawn when they notice something is off, escalating things now would only make it worse.
What's certain now is that this Sinner who claims to be your bride has shown no intention of harming you, even while on the brink of deterioration with an unstable mind. You soften your voice.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If I offer you something you can't refuse, would you tell me a few things? About how I ended up here, and why you chose me, of all people.
Graves shrinks back slightly, her posture alert and wary.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: What offer?
[CG]

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: What did you say?

She lifts her head, emerging from the shadows. Under the moonlight, you finally see the full extent of the contamination covering her body. Her skin is mottled with discoloration, signs of decay corrupting this young body from the inside out.
But she seems to have forgotten all that now, her face showing both incredulous hope and tear tracks left behind from her earlier fear.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: You truly mean it? Even without being bound by spider silk?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll cooperate and see the wedding ceremony through, just as you want.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: You've seen what I look like—aren't you afraid of me? Aren't you afraid of being mocked for marrying a monster?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've seen far more terrifying monsters than you.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Then will you stand with me and accept the blessings from everyone in the castle? I even promised Dullahan he could give a speech on behalf of all the guests. Aren't you afraid of them?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I don't know who Dullahan is, but these guests are your friends, of course it's fine.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: We'll pop the champagne and cut the cake together!
[End CG]

You respond to each of her requests with patience, your voice soft as you address her concerns. Moonlight spills through the latticed windows of the great hall, its silver glow casting a gentle light between you. At last, she has no more questions.

With deep focus, she cradles the ring she has yet to place on your finger, carefully polishing it using the last clean patches of her white veil. When she finally tucks it away, no longer trembling with fear, you let out a sigh of relief.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Wonderful! Now I won't have any regrets. I'll finally have the wedding I've always dreamed of!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So, should we start from the beginning?

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Huh? Right now?

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: No, no, no, no!
Before you can even react, a blue shape, swinging like a rattle drum, retreats back into the shadows.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: N-not now! I'm not presentable! Wait until I transform back—and I still need to fix my makeup... Oh no, my dress is dirty too!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Actually, I don't really mind...

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Well I do mind! What kind of bride would look like this?

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Wait for me. I want you to see me at my most beautiful and perfect self. You should dress up too! It's such a rare occasion, after all.
Get dressed up? Before you can even process this thought or say anything, you feel a sudden grip on your back!

steps.speaker: No. 15
steps.content:
No. 15's skilled with needle and thread! Patch and mend, nothing to dread! Dullahan's got experience to spare! Together we'll help, a reliable pair!
The couple's debut must be perfect indeed, a makeover is what you need!

steps.speaker: Dullahan
steps.content: Struggle. Futile.
What's with this sudden sing-song chant? You spin around toward the source and recognize two figures you'd noticed earlier among the guests.

On the right stands a headless figure, its body completely encased in heavy armor. The one on the left is equally bizarre—a grinning face, crudely stitched together from mismatched parts. You know things are about to go terribly wrong.

options: I think I'll pass on the makeover.

steps.content: You're dragged away without any chance to protest. Though forcibly separated from Graves, your thoughts remain locked on her. You keep thinking about her fixation, and... the dark shadow clinging to her.
[Black Screen Transition]
Only after the monsters have escorted you away with their musical performance does Graves, her body covered in contamination, dare to peek out from hiding.
She gazes at the scattered wedding decorations strewn across the floor, then gently lifts a delicate veil woven from spider silk to her nose, inhaling its scent.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: So you didn't lie to me after all. You really did find me someone willing to be my love.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: All of this feels too good to be true... This isn't just a dream, is it?
The grand hall lies empty and still, but Graves seems locked in conversation with something unseen, her words directed at the empty air.
[Corrupted Graves Appears]

steps.speaker: Graves?
steps.content: If this is a dream, I hope I never wake up from it...

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Please stop!

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: EMP, considerable timidity detected. According to preliminary investigations, this story is largely fabricated. The story shall continue: at midnight, ghosts congregate, playing wedding elegies, with eerie wails of the white ghosts echoing—
The bedtime ghost story session in the Bureau continues. EMP lunges forward to cover Labyrinth's mouth.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: I'm begging you, please let me sleep in peace!

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Labyrinth A.I. Maid III is equipped with an audio system in her chest. Legend has it that the hoary Ghost Bride...

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Aaaaaahhhhh!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Would anyone actually be willing to marry the ghost bride?

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: Negative. The bride, driven by a deep-seated resentment, hence cast a formidable curse, vowing to wait for a destined love—a love that lasts beyond the confines of death.

steps.speaker: Labyrinth
steps.content: An eternal... lover, never... to be pa—rted till death.
[Chief's Lounge]
The Bureau is eerily quiet in the dead of night. Every now and then, a patrolling guard walks past the door, their footsteps echoing before fading down the hallway.

In the Chief's lounge, unnoticed by anyone, a strange fragrance drifts from the picture book at the bedside. Its cloying sweetness, reminiscent of rotting flowers, creeps closer to the sleeping, vulnerable figure on the bed...
